import urllib.request

def get_page_text(title):
    url = f'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&titles={title}&rvslots=*&rvprop=content&format=json'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Bot/1.0'})
